<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Englink Language Academy — Kursus Bahasa Inggris & IELTS</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:wght@500;700;800&family=Figtree:wght@400;500;600&display=swap">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#F6F6F2; --surface:#FFFFFF; --ink:#0B1F4B; --muted:#4A5677; --line:#D9DCE6;
  --blue:#1A7FA6; --on-blue:#FFFFFF; --sun:#F28C1B; --on-sun:#0B1F4B; --mint:#DDF1EA;
  --display:"Bricolage Grotesque","Trebuchet MS",sans-serif; --body:"Figtree","Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;
  color-scheme:light; box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
    --bg:#08142F; --surface:#10204B; --ink:#EEF2FA; --muted:#A8B3D0; --line:#283762;
    --blue:#5CC0E6; --on-blue:#08142F; --mint:#14363A; color-scheme:dark;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg:#08142F; --surface:#10204B; --ink:#EEF2FA; --muted:#A8B3D0; --line:#283762;
  --blue:#5CC0E6; --on-blue:#08142F; --mint:#14363A; color-scheme:dark;
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 1.0625rem/1.6 var(--body)}
a{color:inherit}
.wrap{width:min(1080px,100% - 2.5rem);margin-inline:auto}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:4px}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--display);line-height:1.1;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.02em}
h1{font-size:clamp(2.3rem,6.5vw,4.4rem);font-weight:800}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.7rem,4vw,2.5rem);font-weight:700}
h3{font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:700}
p{margin:0}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:.85rem 1.4rem;border-radius:999px;background:var(--blue);color:var(--on-blue);font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;font:600 1rem var(--body)}
.btn.sun{background:var(--sun);color:var(--on-sun)}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border:2px solid var(--line)}

/* header */
header .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;padding-block:.9rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;text-decoration:none}
.brand img{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:12px;display:block}
.brand b{display:block;font:800 1.3rem/1 var(--display);letter-spacing:-.02em}
.brand small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem;margin-top:.15rem}
nav{display:flex;gap:1.4rem;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
nav a{text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted)}
nav a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
nav a.btn{color:var(--on-blue)}

/* hero */
.hero{padding-block:2.5rem 4rem}
.hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:3rem;align-items:center}
.hero p.lead{margin-top:1.3rem;font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--muted);max-width:34em}
.hero .actions{margin-top:1.8rem;display:flex;gap:.8rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.proof{margin-top:2rem;display:flex;gap:2rem;flex-wrap:wrap;color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
.proof b{display:block;font:700 1.6rem var(--display);color:var(--ink)}

/* quiz */
.quiz{background:var(--surface);border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:20px;padding:1.5rem;box-shadow:8px 8px 0 var(--sun)}
.quiz h2{font-size:1.4rem}
.quiz .sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem;margin:.3rem 0 1rem}
.q-text{font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.8rem;min-height:3.2em}
.opts{display:grid;gap:.5rem}
.opts button{text-align:left;padding:.7rem .9rem;border-radius:12px;border:2px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:500 1rem var(--body);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s}
.opts button:hover{border-color:var(--blue)}
.step{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:1rem}
.bar{height:6px;background:var(--line);border-radius:9px;margin-top:.5rem;overflow:hidden}
.bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--blue);transition:width .3s}
.result .level{font:800 3rem var(--display);color:var(--blue)}
.result p{margin:.4rem 0 1rem}

/* sections */
section{padding-block:4rem}
.head{max-width:36em;margin-bottom:2rem}
.head p{color:var(--muted);margin-top:.6rem}
.programs{border-top:2px solid var(--ink)}
.prog{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.5fr auto;gap:1.5rem;align-items:center;padding-block:1.4rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.prog p{color:var(--muted)}
.tag{background:var(--mint);padding:.25rem .75rem;border-radius:999px;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap}

.band{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg)}
.band .head p,.band .muted{color:inherit;opacity:.8}
.method{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:2rem}
.method h3{margin-bottom:.4rem}
.method .n{display:inline-block;background:var(--sun);color:var(--on-sun);font:800 1rem var(--display);width:2.2rem;height:2.2rem;border-radius:50%;text-align:center;line-height:2.2rem;margin-bottom:.8rem}

.table-wrap{overflow-x:auto}
table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;min-width:620px}
th,td{text-align:left;padding:.9rem 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
th{font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
td:first-child{font-weight:600}
td.price{font:700 1.1rem var(--display)}
td.none{color:var(--muted)}
#biaya{background:var(--sun);color:var(--on-sun)}
#biaya .head p,#biaya th{color:var(--on-sun);opacity:.85}
#biaya th,#biaya td{border-bottom-color:rgba(15,37,87,.25)}
#biaya td.none{color:var(--on-sun);opacity:.6}

blockquote{margin:0;font:600 clamp(1.3rem,3vw,1.9rem)/1.35 var(--display);max-width:26em}
cite{display:block;margin-top:1rem;font:400 1rem var(--body);font-style:normal;opacity:.8}

details{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-block:1rem}
summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem}
summary::after{content:"+";font-size:1.4rem;line-height:1}
details[open] summary::after{content:"−"}
details p{margin-top:.6rem;color:var(--muted);max-width:40em}

.cta{background:var(--sun);color:var(--on-sun);border-radius:28px;padding:3rem 2rem;text-align:center}
.cta img{width:132px;height:132px;border-radius:24px;display:block;margin:0 auto 1.4rem}
.cta p{margin:.8rem auto 1.5rem;max-width:30em}
.cta .btn{background:var(--on-sun);color:var(--sun)}
footer{padding-block:2.5rem;color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
footer .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
footer img{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:9px;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:.6rem}

@media (max-width:820px){
  .hero .wrap,.method{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .prog{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:.5rem}
  .prog .tag{justify-self:start}
  nav .hide-sm{display:none}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <div class="wrap">
    <a class="brand" href="#" aria-label="Englink Language Academy">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Logo Englink Language Academy">
      <span><b>Englink</b><small>Language Academy</small></span>
    </a>
    <nav aria-label="Menu utama">
      <a class="hide-sm" href="#program">Program</a>
      <a class="hide-sm" href="#metode">Metode</a>
      <a class="hide-sm" href="#biaya">Biaya</a>
      <a class="hide-sm" href="#tanya">Tanya jawab</a>
      <a class="btn" href="https://wa.me/6287827897098" rel="noopener">Chat WhatsApp</a>
    </nav>
  </div>
</header>

<main>
<div class="hero">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div>
      <h1>Bahasa Inggris yang kamu pakai, bukan cuma kamu hafal.</h1>
      <p class="lead">Lima program untuk tujuan berbeda: dari IELTS dan wawancara kerja sampai percakapan sehari-hari dan kelas anak. Penjelasan dalam bahasa Inggris dan Indonesia.</p>
      <div class="actions">
        <a class="btn" href="https://wa.me/6287827897098" rel="noopener">Tanya lewat WhatsApp</a>

      <div class="prog">

</section>

<section class="band" id="metode">

      <div><span class="n">2</span><h3>Pakai</h3><p class="muted">Kamu langsung berlatih bicara dan menulis, bukan hanya mendengarkan.</p></div>
      <div><span class="n">3</span><h3>Perbaiki</h3><p class="muted">Jawabanmu dikoreksi, lalu kamu mencoba lagi dengan versi yang lebih baik.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

          <tr><td>IELTS Intensif</td><td class="price">Rp 70.000</td><td class="price">Rp 325.000</td><td class="price">Rp 650.000</td><td class="price">Rp 1.240.000</td></tr>
          <tr><td>General English</td><td class="none">–</td><td class="price">Rp 275.000</td><td class="price">Rp 500.000</td><td class="price">Rp 950.000</td></tr>
          <tr><td>English for Conversation</td><td class="none">–</td><td class="price">Rp 275.000</td><td class="price">Rp 500.000</td><td class="price">Rp 950.000</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Job Interview</td><td class="price">Rp 65.000</td><td class="price">Rp 300.000</td><td class="price">Rp 550.000</td><td class="price">Rp 1.100.000</td></tr>
          <tr><td>English for Kids</td><td class="none">–</td><td class="price">Rp 200.000</td><td class="price">Rp 375.000</td><td class="price">Rp 750.000</td></tr>
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="band">
  <div class="wrap">
    <blockquote>Saya senang Laura udah mulai lancar conversationnya, walau masih sangat minim vocabnya tapi ada banyak kemajuan.
      <cite>Englink Moom</cite>
    </blockquote>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="tanya">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="head"><h2>Pertanyaan yang sering muncul</h2></div>
    <details><summary>Saya pemula total. Apakah bisa ikut?</summary><p>Bisa. General English dan English for Kids cocok untuk memulai dari dasar, dan penjelasan bisa memakai bahasa Indonesia.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Paket sesi mana yang sebaiknya saya pilih?</summary><p>Untuk mencoba dulu, ambil paket 5 sesi. Paket 10 dan 20 sesi lebih hemat per pertemuan bila kamu sudah yakin dengan targetmu.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Apakah ada program untuk anak?</summary><p>Ada. English for Kids dirancang dengan aktivitas yang sesuai usia anak. Tanyakan rentang usia lewat WhatsApp.</p></details>
    <details><summary>Apakah ada jaminan nilai IELTS?</summary><p>Tidak ada jaminan nilai, tetapi latihan soal dan umpan balik di setiap sesi membantu progresmu terukur.</p></details>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="daftar" style="padding-top:0">

    <div class="cta">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Logo Englink Language Academy">

      <p>Hubungi kami lewat WhatsApp untuk memilih program dan paket sesi yang cocok.</p>
      <a class="btn" href="https://wa.me/6287827897098" rel="noopener">Chat WhatsApp 0878-2789-7098</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
</main>

<footer>
  <div class="wrap">
    <span><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="">© 2026 Englink Language Academy</span>
    
  </div>
</footer>

<script>
(function(){
  var qs=[
    {t:"Pilih kalimat yang benar:",o:["She don’t like coffee.","She doesn’t like coffee.","She not like coffee."],a:1},
    {t:"I ___ in Jakarta since 2019.",o:["live","am living","have lived"],a:2},
    {t:"If I had more time, I ___ learn another language.",o:["will","would","am going to"],a:1},
    {t:"The report ___ by the team before the deadline.",o:["finished","was finished","has finish"],a:1},
    {t:"He never gives up easily. He is very ___.",o:["persistent","persuasive","precise"],a:0}
  ];
  var res=[
    ["A2","Kamu cocok mulai dari dasar. General English atau English for Kids bisa jadi pilihan."],
    ["B1","Fondasimu sudah ada. General English atau English for Conversation cocok untukmu."],
    ["B1","Fondasimu sudah ada. General English atau English for Conversation cocok untukmu."],
    ["B2","Levelmu sudah menengah atas. IELTS Intensif atau Job Interview bisa langsung kamu coba."]
  ];
  var i=0,score=0,box=document.getElementById("quiz-body");
  function show(){
    if(i>=qs.length){return done();}
    var q=qs[i];
    box.innerHTML='<p class="q-text"></p><div class="opts"></div><p class="step">Pertanyaan '+(i+1)+' dari '+qs.length+'</p><div class="bar"><i style="width:'+(i/qs.length*100)+'%"></i></div>';
    box.querySelector(".q-text").textContent=q.t;
    var wrap=box.querySelector(".opts");
    q.o.forEach(function(text,idx){
      var b=document.createElement("button");b.type="button";b.textContent=text;
      b.onclick=function(){if(idx===q.a)score++;i++;show();};
      wrap.appendChild(b);
    });
  }
  function done(){
    var r=res[score<2?0:score<4?1:3];
    box.innerHTML='<div class="result"><div class="level">'+r[0]+'</div><p>'+r[1]+'</p><a class="btn sun" href="https://wa.me/6287827897098" rel="noopener">Tanya lewat WhatsApp</a> <button class="btn ghost" type="button" id="again">Ulangi</button><p class="step">Ini hanya perkiraan awal, bukan hasil tes resmi.</p></div>';
    document.getElementById("again").onclick=function(){i=0;score=0;show();};
  }
  show();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
